ObjectName.value: Fresh Noodles and Wrapped Tofu on Market Display

Categories.value: Self-published work|WikiClub Davao|Philippine Knowledge Continuity Project

ImageDescription.value: This indoor high-angle photograph captures a market counter showcasing fresh yellow noodles alongside neatly organized blocks of tofu. Piles of bright yellow noodles rest directly on the white counter and inside a blue plastic-lined container on the left. To the right, a clear plastic container resting on a yellow bucket holds tightly stacked blocks of white tofu meticulously wrapped in green banana leaves and clear plastic film. The overhead lighting highlights the smooth surfaces, organic textures, and vibrant green and yellow color contrast, offering an authentic glimpse into regional marketplace inventory, local food vendor culture, and daily community commerce.

Credit.value: Own work
